name: App windows
description: Other Mac apps in a tab of the desktop app, next to your notes: Spotify, Messages, any app with a window. The app's own window is kept right behind the tab, so it works as it always does; closing the tab gives it back where it was.

newWindows.label: New windows as tabs
newWindows.description: a new window from an app in a tab (Brave's ⌘N, a link opened in a new window) opens in a tab next to it; false leaves it a window of its own
